units.source_text: 我几乎为这种光和在光之下进行的这种活动而感到眩晕。

en.t: I was almost dizzy from this light and from the activity taking place beneath it.

units.source_text: 忽然间，我又脱离了蜜蜂的眼睛，还原为我的眼睛，这时凝望着这种情况的我的眼睛，恰好落在金阁的眼睛的位置上。

en.t: Suddenly, I once again broke away from the bee's eyes and returned to my own eyes; at that moment, my eyes as they gazed at this scene happened to fall into the position of the Golden Pavilion's eyes.

units.source_text: 事情是这样的：正如我停止了我是蜜蜂的眼睛并还原为我的眼睛一样，

en.t: The situation was this: just as I had ceased to be the bee's eyes and returned to my own eyes,

units.source_text: 生逼迫我的一刹那，我停止了我的眼睛，而把金阁的眼睛完全当做我的眼睛了。

en.t: at the instant when life pressed in upon me, I ceased using my own eyes and completely took the Golden Pavilion's eyes as my own.

units.source_text: 正是这时候，金阁在我和生之间出现了。

en.t: It was precisely then that the Golden Pavilion appeared between me and life.
